capabilities: Display checkbox tasks on a monthly calendar
Draw multi-day bars from start and due dates
Collect undated unfinished tasks in a pending panel
Assign custom card and marker colors
disambiguation: Not a recurring-task or monthly-review tool; it displays existing Markdown checkbox tasks on a monthly calendar.
extras: Version 0.1 is verified on desktop only. Colors, marker colors and panel state are stored in the plugin's data.json, so syncing notes alone does not carry them to another device. README is also provided in Chinese.
problem: Dated Markdown checkbox tasks are scattered across notes, so there is no month-level view of what is scheduled, upcoming or overdue without installing a Kanban or Tasks plugin.

relations.evidence: Reads existing Kanban notes without depending on Kanban columns or modifying the board.

summary: Monthly calendar that shows Markdown checkbox tasks, including multi-day bars, with custom colors, a pending-tasks panel and quick task creation.
